blocks.en:
LOGICAL “PLANES” OF NETWORK FUNCTIONS 
What does a ROUTER do?
blocks.zh:
網路功能的邏輯“平面”
何謂?路由器怎麼樣?

blocks.en:
• 
It forwards messages between networks by examining information in the Layer 3 header 
• 
It uses a routing protocol like OSPF to share route information with other routers and build a 
routing table 
• 
It uses ARP to build an ARP table, mapping IP Addresses to MAC Addresses 
• 
It uses Syslog to keep logs of events that occur 
• 
and MUCH more… 
What does a SWITCH do?

segments.en: It forwards messages between networks by examining information in the Layer 3 header
segments.zh: 它透過檢查層中的資訊來傳遞網路間的資訊3標頭.

segments.en: It uses a routing protocol like OSPF to share route information with other routers and build a routing table
segments.zh: 它使用類似OSPF的路由協議與其他路由器共享路由資訊並構建路由表.

segments.en: It uses ARP to build an ARP table, mapping IP Addresses to MAC Addresses
segments.zh: 它使用ARP來構建一個ARP表,將IP Addresses對映到MAC Addresses.

segments.en: It uses Syslog to keep logs of events that occur
segments.zh: 它使用 Syslog 來儲存事件日誌

•

• 
It uses STP to ensure there are no Layer 2 loops in the network 
•

• 
It uses Syslog to keep logs of events that occur 
• 
It allows a user to connect to it via SSH and manage it

blocks.en:
The various functions of network devices can be logically divided up (categorized) into PLANES 
- DATA PLANE 
- CONTROL PLANE 
- MANAGEMENT PLANE

segments.en: The various functions of network devices can be logically divided up (categorized) into PLANES
segments.zh: 網路裝置的各種功能可以邏輯上分為(分類)平面.

blocks.zh:
網路裝置的各種功能可以邏輯上分為(分類)平面.
- 資料平面
- 控制平面
- 管理平面

blocks.en:
• 
The operations of the MANAGEMENT PLANE and the CONTROL PLANE are usually managed 
by the CPU 
• 
However, this is not desirable for DATA PLANE operations because CPU processing is slow 
(relatively speaking) 
• 
Instead, a specialized hardware ASIC (Application-Specific Integrated Circuit) is used.

segments.en: The operations of the MANAGEMENT PLANE and the CONTROL PLANE are usually managed by the CPU
segments.zh: 管理平面和控制平面的運營通常由CPU管理.

segments.en: However, this is not desirable for DATA PLANE operations because CPU processing is slow (relatively speaking)
segments.zh: 然而,這對資料平面業務來說並不可取,因為CPU處理緩慢(相對而言)

segments.en: Instead, a specialized hardware ASIC (Application-Specific Integrated Circuit) is used.
segments.zh: 取而代之的是專用硬體ASIC(應用-特定積體電路).
